summary: Ran fresh interaction checks at 1440 and 390 px in separate isolated headless Chrome contexts. Both loads returned HTTP 200 with no page errors; quantity changed from 1 to 2 and restored to 1 by keyboard. No cart, order, payment, form submission or email action was performed. Variant selection and the wholesale-inquiry dialog have material failures.
issues: PB-INT-001 | priority: critical | property: package-size variation selection | expected: 4 ha, 10 ha and 12 ha are real focusable/selectable WooCommerce variation controls whose state and price can change | actual: all three are static span elements (tabIndex -1, no role, no aria-pressed, cursor auto); 10 ha is permanently marked is-active and no variation button exists at desktop or mobile | fix: implement the real native variation form/options with keyboard-accessible controls and state/price synchronization.

PB-INT-002 | priority: critical | property: wholesale inquiry dialog | expected: opening reveals a complete accessible dialog/form that can be closed by its control and Escape at desktop and mobile | actual: the opened section has no dialog role/aria-modal and is visually empty; Escape leaves is-inquiry-open set, and at 390 px the close button cannot receive a real pointer click because the sticky header intercepts it | fix: render the sourced inquiry form/content, add dialog semantics/focus handling, make Escape close it, and position the mobile close control outside header interception.

PB-INT-003 | priority: medium | property: quantity stepper controls | expected: visible minus/value/plus controls support pointer and keyboard use | actual: only a plain number input and submit button exist; keyboard ArrowUp/ArrowDown works and restores, but no decrement/increment buttons are present | fix: add the source-matching accessible stepper controls around the native quantity input.

PB-INT-004 | priority: info | property: cart submission coverage | expected: no business-side-effect action during this audit | actual: the enabled 'Dodaj do koszyka' submit control was identified but intentionally not clicked | fix: none in this checkpoint; validate cart mutation only in the separately authorized session-safe commerce check.
